# Landscape contact sheet matches all three Instant Exports shots

> On the landscape contact sheet, inspect measured dimensions, duration, frame rate and all three shots, including exact titles, counter endpoints and sustained URL visibility.

## Step 1 @verifies ac-18, ac-1, ac-2, ac-3, ac-4, ac-5

Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=16x9 in the browser and inspect the Ledgerline landscape contact-sheet header after it reads “ready”, then assert it measures 1920×1080 pixels, reports a duration of 10 seconds and 30 fps, and declares shots at 0:00–0:03, 0:03–0:07 and 0:07–0:10.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-6, ac-7, ac-8

In the landscape sheet’s labelled shot-1 frames and layer facts table for 0:00–0:03, inspect the hook, then assert the title is exactly “Exports in one click” on dark navy with exactly one lime accent line drawn left to right.

## Step 3 @verifies ac-9, ac-10, ac-11, ac-12, ac-13

In the landscape sheet’s labelled shot-2 frames and layer facts table for 0:03–0:07, inspect the proof card at the specified timecodes, then assert a white app card contains a three-row table and a lime “Export CSV” button, with the counter reading 0 at 0:03 and exactly 10,000 rows by 0:06.

## Step 4 @verifies ac-14, ac-15

In the landscape sheet’s labelled shot-3 frames and layer facts table for 0:07–0:10, inspect the call to action and every labelled frame from 0:08 through the final frame, then assert the text reads exactly “Live today for every plan” and ledgerline.app is visible in each frame from 0:08 to the end.

# Portrait contact sheet has no content in the bottom 35%

> On the portrait contact sheet, inspect all frames for any content in the bottom 35% of the image; detect prohibited occupancy, not merely show the safe-zone overlay.

## Step 1

Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=9x16 in the browser and reach the Ledgerline portrait contact sheet once its header reads “ready”.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-16

On the portrait contact sheet, turn on “Show safe zones” and inspect every labelled storyboard frame against the shaded bottom 35% band, then assert no rendered content occupies that bottom band in any frame.
